      "snippet": "SEE in MetaBlooms stands for Search–Extract–Evidence.
It is a governance-grade evidence engine, not a general research feature and not a synonym for “looking things up.” SEE exists to prevent ungrounded claims and to force external truth anchoring when required.

What SEE Is (Precisely)
SEE is a controlled pipeline that:

Searches external sources with an explicit query plan

Extracts verbatim facts, quotes, or data from those sources

Attaches Evidence (citations, provenance, timestamps) to eve"
